turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
“Doctor, I’ve been much more confused lately, and I can’t seem to put my thoughts into words like before. I also have a fever around 102°F, and it hurts when you press on my right upper abdomen.”
Can you tell me if you have noticed any yellowing of
“Doctor, yes—I think my skin looks more yellow than usual, and my family also mentioned my eyes seem yellow.”
Have you felt lightheaded, dizzy, or passed out
“Doctor, I haven’t passed out, but I do feel quite lightheaded and weak at times, and my dizziness comes and goes.”
Have you ever been told you have gallstones, or have you had any previous issues with your gallbladder or liver?

“Doctor, I’m not sure of the exact diagnosis, but I’ve had chronic liver or gallbladder problems discussed in the past while I was under hospice care.” “I don’t remember being told specifically about gallstones, though there may have been mentions of gallbladder inflammation.”

“Doctor, I haven’t had any vomiting that I recall, but the fever started and the confusion has gotten worse since then, and the right upper belly area has been very tender. I don’t know about SBP or cholangitis—my family just says I seem much more out of it than before.”
